text:
[Council File 26-1284]
Motion (Nazarian – Park) relative to a study of the potential impacts of data center development; and establishing a temporary moratorium on the development of new data center facilities that require more than 100 megawatts within the City pending completion of the study.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion for a study of data center impacts and a temporary moratorium on new data centers needing more than 100 megawatts.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee action: Approved as Amended (Nov 13, 2026)

flag.reason: Citywide moratorium proposal on large data centers; the committee put it off with no new date.
